scripts.build: npm run build -w @sitespec/core && npm run build -w @sitespec/template && npm run build -w @sitespec/astro && npm run build -w @sitespec/cli && npm run build -w @sitespec/create
scripts.release:check: node scripts/verify-release-runtime.mjs && npm test && npm run release:verify && npm run release:pack && npm run release:smoke
scripts.release:version: node scripts/verify-release-runtime.mjs && changeset version && node scripts/verify-packages.mjs
